articles.title: US charges ex-Robinhood engineers over alleged pre-listing crypto trades
articles.description: The former employees allegedly earned more than $50,000 each by trading Hyperliquid perpetuals ahead of Robinhood token listings.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $450M in biggest outflow since June
articles.description: The $450 million withdrawal came as Bitcoin fell 2.5% and the CLARITY Act failed to advance in the Senate, with Fidelity and BlackRock funds leading the outflows.

articles.title: Crypto industry turns to US regulators after CLARITY setback
articles.description: The CLARITY Act still has a procedural path after Senator Thom Tillis moved to reconsider the failed cloture vote, though industry executives are divided over whether Congress has enough time left.

articles.title: BIS paper finds major gap in Bitcoin onchain transfer estimates
articles.description: A BIS study found widely used crypto metrics can obscure economic activity, with measurement challenges spanning Bitcoin, Ethereum and stablecoins.

articles.title: Crypto stocks slide after CLARITY Act fails to advance in Senate
articles.description: Circle and Coinbase shares fell about 10% as the failed Senate vote weighed on crypto-linked equities, with Bitcoin miners and treasury companies also declining.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: US Senate fails to advance CLARITY Act
articles.description: The failed procedural vote leaves the CLARITY Act facing an uncertain future after months of negotiations over crypto oversight and ethics provisions.

articles.title: Stablecoin growth could boost dollar dominance, US Treasury demand: BoE official
articles.description: A Bank of England policy maker said digital dollars could expand access to the US currency while turning stablecoin issuers into bigger buyers of government debt.

articles.title: Binance adds 11 US-listed ETFs to wealth management offering
articles.description: The crypto exchange is expanding its traditional finance offerings with 11 US-listed exchange-traded funds focused on US Treasurys and investment-grade bonds.

articles.title: Bitcoin price falls to $75.6K September low as global bonds hit multidecade highs
articles.description: Bitcoin price action weakened over market nerves prior to the Senate CLARITY Act vote, while surging bond yields pressured risk assets across the board.

articles.title: Standard Chartered says Arbitrum could outperform Bitcoin, Ether through 2030
articles.description: Standard Chartered sees Robinhood Chain as an early sign that tokenization could transform Arbitrum’s economics and drive ARB sharply higher by 2030.

articles.title: ETH wallet exploit backfires as MEV bot captures $7.7M, Kelp freezes address
articles.description: An MEV bot known as “Yoink” front-ran an attacker attempting to exploit a custom Safe module, capturing the stolen rsETH before Kelp temporarily froze the receiving address.

articles.title: USDT payments feature in Polish energy giant’s failed $230M oil deal: FT
articles.description: Tether’s USDT stablecoin was part of a failed oil trade that reportedly cost a Polish energy giant $230 million in late 2023.

articles.title: US House crypto tax package omits mining, staking reward deferral
articles.description: The 114-page bill would change the tax treatment of crypto fees, stablecoins and lending while leaving existing reward-tax timing unchanged.

articles.title: Ethereum, Base wallet standards talks fail, Ethlabs researcher says
articles.description: Ethereum and Base are pursuing different account abstraction designs after talks failed, according to Ethlabs researcher Derek Chiang.

articles.title: Bitcoin short-term holders hit 30-day profit streak as bull-market odds improve: CryptoQuant
articles.description: Bitcoin short-term holders approached a full month in partial profit as analysis saw improving odds of an enduring bullish BTC price reversal.

articles.title: US seeks $61M in USDT allegedly tied to sanctioned Iranian oil sales
articles.description: Tether froze $61.19 million across 10 Tron addresses in 2025 that prosecutors allege were connected to black-market Iranian oil proceeds.

articles.title: Solana more than triples transaction size limit with mainnet upgrade
articles.description: Solana raised its transaction size limit to 4,096 bytes, giving developers more room for zero-knowledge proofs and transactions with multiple signatures.

articles.title: CLARITY Act odds fall to 16% as key Democrats resist GOP’s ‘final’ offer
articles.description: Banking groups also said the GOP’s final text leaves stablecoin reward loopholes, while tribal gaming interests warn that its prediction market provisions threaten tribal sovereignty.

articles.title: CoinEx to cease operation after 9 years, citing ‘significant’ crypto contraction
articles.description: CoinEx said falling trading volumes and liquidity, along with rising regulatory and compliance costs, had exceeded “reasonable boundaries,” with withdrawals remaining open until Dec. 22.

articles.title: Balancer eyes wind-down after restructuring fails to revive revenue
articles.description: Balancer cut costs and shipped new products after restructuring, but Marcus Hardt says v3 failed to replace legacy revenue as November’s $128 million exploit continued to weigh on adoption.

articles.title: Democrats push back on GOP’s ‘final’ CLARITY offer with counterproposal: Politico
articles.description: Some Democrats remain dissatisfied with the bill’s crypto ethics provisions and will be sending a counterproposal just hours before a key procedural vote.

articles.title: Kraken brings DeFi yield to tokenized stocks and ETFs
articles.description: Kraken’s new xStocks vaults let investors earn yield on tokenized versions of Nvidia and major US stock market ETFs by lending the assets in DeFi markets.

articles.title: Bitcoin tops $79K, oil falls as Trump says Iran war could end
articles.description: Bitcoin’s price rose toward $80,000 after US President Donald Trump hinted that the US-Iran war would end, pushing oil prices lower.

articles.title: Strive adds 469 Bitcoin to reach 25,000 BTC treasury
articles.description: Strive’s latest Bitcoin purchase was funded entirely through its SATA preferred stock as the company continues its rapid climb among corporate BTC holders.

articles.title: CLARITY Act faces state AGs opposition ahead of key Senate vote
articles.description: Trump’s ethics concession addresses one hurdle for the crypto bill, but 18 state attorneys general say the revised legislation would weaken state oversight.

articles.title: S&P Global backs Kaiko as Series B reaches $110M
articles.description: The investment brings together major financial institutions as Kaiko expands its data infrastructure for tokenized securities and onchain financial markets.

articles.title: Bitmine projects $334M in annual staking revenue from $15.8B crypto treasury
articles.description: Bitmine now has more than 5 million ETH staked, turning most of its Ether holdings into a recurring income stream as it continues to accumulate.

articles.title: Why are AI’s biggest companies suddenly asking to slow down?
articles.description: AI’s biggest labs are suddenly calling for a slower pace of development. Is it because AI risks are catching up with the technology, or because the economics of the race are getting harder to justify?

articles.title: Fragmented regulations limit stablecoin adoption in international finance: WTO head
articles.description: Stablecoins may reduce trade finance friction, fragmented regulatory regimes limit their adoption to just 3% of global payments, according to the World Trade Organization.
